instruction: A cinematic still, medium over-the-shoulder shot taken at an outdoor waterfront. In the foreground, the man in the beige corduroy shirt (R1) stands with his back turned to the camera. Facing him, the woman in the beige hijab and black polka-dot dress (R2) looks down with a gentle, serene smile. She rests her left hand on his right shoulder in a close, affectionate embrace. The background consists of a soft-focus lake and distant hazy hills under a bright sky. Soft, diffused natural daylight illuminates the couple, casting gentle shadows.
